Still, A said they wanted to leave, and you stood in the only doorway for five minutes, so A could not get out. However urgent a resolution feels, blocking someone's exit takes away their choice, and it can be frightening for them. Next time, try agreeing on a specific time to come back to the conversation, and use calming steps for your own panic while you wait.
